It can rewind the bounded 32 MiB/64-call/5-second window since the last full device flush; published checkpoints share these bounds. checkpoint_durable retains an explicit strong boundary and is NOT requested by this fixture. Finalization and current checkpoint calls are included. This changed sync acknowledgment contract is explicit, not equivalent power-loss durability.
